patients.summary: Elementary school teacher who joined in 2021 healthy apart from frequent childhood respiratory infections. Lupus with arthropathy is diagnosed by rheumatology in 2024 and a C1q gene mutation is found; in June 2026, after a cold and after his last practice visit, he goes to the ED with poststreptococcal glomerulonephritis and is followed by nephrology.

conditions.label: History of frequent upper respiratory infections
conditions.note: Frequent colds and sinus infections as a child, per patient

medications.sig: Take 1 capsule (2000 IU) by mouth daily

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
25M here to establish. Teaches 2nd grade locally, moved from his old doctor because the office kept losing his messages. No complaints today.

PMH: says he was 'the kid who always had a cold' - lots of colds and sinus infections growing up, a few rounds of antibiotics a year as a child, much less as an adult. Nothing chronic. No hospitalizations.
PSH: none.
Meds: vitamin D3 2000 units daily, his own idea, takes it most days.
Allergies: none to medications.
FHx: mom has lupus (dx in her mid 30s). Maternal aunt with rheumatoid arthritis. Dad has high blood pressure.
SH: single, lives alone in an apartment. Never smoked. A drink or two a month. No drugs. Plays pickup basketball on weekends.
Vaccines: COVID primary series done in March through the school district clinic, card reviewed. Thinks he had a tetanus shot 'a few years ago' - will check old records.

ROS: negative except as above. No joint pain, rashes, mouth sores, fevers.

Exam: vitals as charted, BP fine. Well-appearing. HEENT: TMs clear, oropharynx clear, no ulcers. Neck supple, no nodes. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abd soft, nontender. Skin: no rashes. Joints: full ROM, no swelling. Neuro grossly normal.
PHQ-2 0.

A/P: healthy 25M establishing care.
- Baseline CBC, CMP, lipids. One-time HIV and hep C screening, discussed and he agrees.
- Records release signed for prior PCP.
- Family hx of lupus noted; nothing to suggest it in him. Told him what to watch for.
- Flu shot in the fall.
- Physical yearly.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Curtis - everything from Tuesday came back normal. Blood counts, kidney and liver numbers, and cholesterol all look good, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens are negative. Nothing to do until your physical next year.

documents.title: Prior Primary Care Records
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Records received from prior primary care practice, 38 pages, covering 2013-2020.

Summary for chart: annual physicals 2016, 2017, 2019 with normal exams. Problem list there: recurrent URIs in childhood (noted as history). No chronic medications. NKDA. Tdap given 08/22/2017. No labs of note; CBC and BMP from 2019 normal.

Immunization history entered. Scanned to media tab.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Influenza Vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In after school for flu vaccine. Screening questions negative, no egg or vaccine reactions. Quadrivalent flu 0.5 mL IM left deltoid. Tolerated well, waited 15 min. VIS given.

documents.title: Booster
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Got my COVID booster Saturday at the pharmacy, Pfizer again. Attaching a picture of the card so you have it.

documents.title: RE: Booster
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Thanks Curtis, booster added to your immunization record.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: First week of summer break, feels good. Only one cold all winter, which he says is a record for a teacher. Still on vitamin D. No joint pain, rash, sores in his mouth. Exercising - basketball twice a week.
No smoking, rare alcohol.

O: vitals reviewed and fine. Pleasant, well. Ears, throat clear. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear throughout. Abdomen soft. Skin clear. No synovitis.
PHQ-2 negative.

A/P: well visit, 26M.
- Labs were normal last year, nothing due.
- Tdap current (2017). Flu and COVID in the fall.
- Sunscreen, seat belt, the usual.
- See him next summer.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Vaccines
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Pt here for both fall shots. Denies fever today, no prior reactions. Flu (quadrivalent) L deltoid IM. Pfizer bivalent booster R deltoid IM. Observed 15 minutes without issue. Pt asked if he could still teach tomorrow - yes.

documents.title: Appointment Cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt called, needs to move his physical, helping a colleague pack up her classroom tomorrow. Rebooked 7/11 at 10:40.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
27 yo M, yearly visit (moved from last month).

Interval: no illnesses worth mentioning. A little more tired in the spring with report cards but sleeping fine now. Mood good. Vitamin D continues. No joint, skin or mouth complaints.
Social unchanged; never smoker, occasional drink.

Exam: VS ok. General well. Oropharynx without lesions. CV RRR. Lungs CTA. Abd benign. Ext no edema. Skin no rash.
PHQ-2: 1.

Plan:
- CBC and BMP since he mentioned the spring fatigue, mostly for reassurance.
- Fall vaccines here in October.
- Back in a year.

documents.title: Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Curtis, your blood count and chemistry panel are normal - no anemia, kidneys and sugar fine. Glad the energy is back.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Vaccines
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Fall vaccines. No contraindications on screening. Flu IM L arm, Moderna 2023-24 COVID IM R arm. VIS sheets given, observed, left without problems.
